rdfs:label: contentMap
rdfs:comment: The language-map JSON form of ActivityStreams `content` — keys are BCP 47 language tags, values are the localised content (often HTML). Not a distinct RDF property: it expands to `as:content` with language-tagged literals.
notes: In the AS2 JSON-LD context `contentMap` is an alias, `{"@id": "as:content", "@container": "@language"}` — there is no `as:contentMap` IRI in expanded data; each map entry becomes an `as:content` literal tagged with that language. To expand correctly the context must declare the `@language` container, as the example does inline. The fediverse's standard mechanism for multi-language posts. Mastodon, Misskey, and most ActivityPub servers populate this when an author tags a post's language. Clients select on locale; server-side translation features (Mastodon "translate") add machine-translated entries here. It carries no owl:sameAs of its own: the RDF property is `https://www.w3.org/ns/activitystreams#content`, which the registry maps via `urn:solid:content`; this term only names the JSON-LD alias.

contentMap.fr: Je viens de livrer une nouvelle fonctionnalité.

history.note: owl:sameAs now as:content; documented contentMap as a @language-container alias; example carries inline context so it expands. owl:sameAs moved to seeAlso (one registry term per upstream IRI).
